import.title: Data
import.subtitle: Import and export your data.
import.uploadStatementDesc: Select a card or "Exported Data (PDF)", then choose a CSV file (Amex, Apple) or a previously downloaded export PDF. CSV imports skip transactions that already exist (same date and amount). Exported data imports skip by ID. After reviewing the preview, click "Add to transactions" or "Add all" to save—they persist across refreshes and appear on the Transactions and Income pages.
import.previewDescPdf: मौजूदा ID वाले लेनदेन और आय छोड़े गए। बाकी जोड़ने "सभी जोड़ें" क्लिक करें।
import.previewDescCsv: मौजूदा प्रविष्टियों से मेल खाते लेनदेन (समान तारीख और राशि) छोड़े जाते हैं। जरूरत हो तो पंक्ति के अनुसार श्रेणी संपादित करें, फिर "लेनदेन में जोड़ें"।
import.missingMetaDesc: This import includes categories/owners not in your settings.
import.exportStringDesc: Paste the exported data string (starts with BUDGET_TOOL_DATA_START or V2).
import.jsonImportDesc: Import a JSON export file created by this app.
import.exportDesc: Download your data as PDF, JSON, or an export string.

dashboard.introContent: View spending, income, and savings by month. Use the steps below to find key areas.
dashboard.monthSelectorContent: Pick which month to view. The dashboard shows totals and breakdowns for the selected month.
dashboard.summaryContent: Summary cards show total earned, spent, and saved for the selected month.
dashboard.overviewContent: Charts and breakdowns for earned vs spent, spending by type, and income by category.
dashboard.debtContent: Remaining debt balance and total paid off. Go to the Debt page to add or manage debts.
dashboard.byMonthContent: Monthly breakdown of earned vs spent across all months.

transactions.introContent: Browse, filter, and edit expense transactions. Use the toolbar to filter or add new entries.
transactions.toolbarContent: Filter by month, source, category, or search. Add a transaction or sync to Google Sheets if connected.
transactions.expensesListContent: Tap a row to edit category or delete. Select multiple to delete in bulk.

import.introContent: Import transactions from CSV or PDF. Choose a source, upload a file, then add to transactions.
import.uploadCardContent: Select Amex, Apple Card, Chase, or exported PDF. Choose a file to preview.
import.previewCardContent: Review expenses and income before adding. Duplicates (same date and amount) are skipped.

income.introContent: Track paychecks, rent, and other income. Add entries and edit or delete below.
income.addIncomeContent: Add a new income entry with date, amount, description, and category.
income.incomeListContent: Edit or delete income entries. Recurring income can be set for paychecks or rent.

debt.introContent: Track loans and debt payments. Add a debt, then record payments to see the balance go down.
debt.addDebtContent: Add a new debt with name and initial amount. You can set recurring payments later.
debt.debtListContent: View balance and payment history. Make payments or edit recurring from each debt.

mortgage.introContent: Record mortgage payments. They are excluded from the Transactions list but included in spending totals.
mortgage.addPaymentContent: Record a mortgage payment with date and amount.
mortgage.paymentsListContent: View all mortgage payments. Remove a payment if entered by mistake.

settings.introContent: Connect Google Sheets, manage expense and income categories, and delete all data if needed.
settings.googleSheetsContent: Connect your account and set a spreadsheet ID to sync or restore data.
settings.categoriesContent: Edit expense and income categories. They appear in dropdowns and presets.
settings.deleteAllContent: Permanently remove all expenses, income, debts, and presets from this device.

landing.heroTagline: एक जगह खर्च, आय और बजट ट्रैक करें।
landing.valueProp: Amex, Apple Card और Chase से इम्पोर्ट करें। खर्च कैटेगराइज़ करें, Google Sheets के साथ सिंक करें।
landing.featureImportDesc: Import from CSV or export to PDF, JSON, or string.
landing.featureRulesDesc: Create reusable transaction templates for quick-fill.
landing.featureSheetsDesc: स्प्रेडशीट में डेटा पुश और पुल।
landing.featurePdfDesc: ट्रांजैक्शन और आय PDF में एक्सपोर्ट करें।
